title: LXC 111: implement the media request capability (Radarr/Sonarr request path)
description:
On LXC 111, add a backend route that takes a movie/TV title and calls the Radarr (192.168.1.22:7878) and Sonarr lookup/add APIs to make the media server fetch it, using API keys read from a config file the operator's values populate. No UI yet. On container 111.

[Engine split of ADD100 — 3 of 8] Done when the capability WORKS, not when its code exists (operator decision 2026-10-07): `pct exec 111 -- curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Sintel","type":"movie"}' http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/media-request` answers with Radarr's own reply for Sintel (the movie, or Radarr's message that it is already in the library -- ADD134 added it) and NOT a missing-key, 401 or connection error. (The path follows the capability registry that ADD121 built: config/capabilities.json gives this capability the id `media-request`.)
